lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Don't. Rack down there wakes on movement. You get about four seconds of being interesting before it decides what you are.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Tomas Hale. Ash Camp. Eleven days on this ridge.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Counting what comes out of that sand. Four hundred and one so far. Same outline every time. Same length of rebar, same gait, same stop at the same forty metres. Don't know why. Stopped expecting to.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Not for want of the Basin trying.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Kell sent rifles down in the spring. Crates of them, down the actual road, in daylight. First time in my life anybody sent us anything that wasn't a message about why they couldn't.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: You're going down there, then. You've got the look.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: I've watched eleven parties go down. None of them had it. That's why they're still down there.

choices.text: Come with us. You know the ground.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Ridge is a ridge. I'll be on it.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Four hundred and one. Every one the same outline. Stopped counting. Started listening instead. There's a rhythm to it and I'd rather there wasn't.
